question: Should OpenClaw accept this CLI catalog as a core stable CLI/plugin API now, keep it experimental behind the RFC until the contract is narrowed, or decline it from core for now?
rationale: The PR creates public JSON commands, prompt behavior, scripts, docs, and plugin descriptor metadata; automation cannot choose the permanent API/product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Wait for RFC contract
options.body: Keep the PR draft/open until the linked RFC or an equivalent maintainer decision defines the stable catalog scope and preferred stack shape.

options.title: Accept as experimental core surface
options.body: Proceed only after explicit experimental wording, plugin SDK docs, and real behavior proof make the compatibility risk visible.

options.title: Decline core catalog for now
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers decide the catalog should live outside core or return only after a narrower plugin/API need is proven.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC contract
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft/open until the linked RFC or an equivalent maintainer decision defines the stable catalog scope and preferred stack shape.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current owner signal across product direction, plugin contract, CLI, docs, and prompt-surface history for this change.
